en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a baroque entrance façade with a grand semicircular staircase leading up to three arches. In the central arch is an ornate niche with a statue. Decorative railings flank the steps, and the building features a tiled roof and sculpted pediment. Trees frame the view. Printed caption text runs vertically along the right side; the right half of the card is blank for writing and address.
